STARRED. First insurer account in the CRM. IMPORTANT COMMERCIAL FINDING, 2026-09-07: BHSI has NO marine war risk product. Its marine book is cargo and stock-throughput led, plus a large US/Canada inland marine book (which is not maritime at all). It writes commercial HULL in only two places — Australasia, entered August 2022, and Singapore, per its MAS regulatory disclosure of January 2026. Hull appears nowhere on the US or UK product pages. It holds no Joint War Committee seat and employs no war-risk underwriter. The only war exposure evidenced is cargo War & Strikes as an Institute Cargo Clauses extension. So the warm relationship is real, but a war-risk pitch cannot be routed through London — it has to go through cargo war & strikes, or through the hull book in Sydney or Singapore. Global marine sits under Cathy Miller, Global CUO Property & Marine; Ben Wyatt reports into Sanjay Godhwani, Head of North America. Berkshire Hathaway wrote $120.3m of US ocean marine in 2025, down 57%, falling from #6 to #15 (AM Best), and is one of the seven US carriers in the DFC Hormuz facility, which never wrote a policy. Tier 6 sequence copy now exists — see crm/sequences.json. Every tier 6 send is read by a human first. See insurance-market.json.
